asks: Do you know what is on the other side? Genuinely?
Would you like me to stay open?
description: Two upright stones and a lintel, cut with a border of small figures walking in one direction. The gap between them is dark and gives out a steady cool draught.
emotes: The draught out of {it} lifts the dust on the floor and lays it in a line.
The figures carved along {it} are, for a moment, one step further along.
{it} stands there being a way out, patiently, with no opinion about it.
looks: The figures on the border are all walking the same way, and they are all carrying something, and none of them are carrying the same thing.
The threshold stone is worn into a hollow deep enough to hold rain.
The dark inside the gap does not get lighter when you bring a light to it. It simply accommodates you.
name: a temple gate
says: Through is through. It has always been that simple.
Wipe your feet. Somebody has always had to say it.
They all went the same way. It did not go badly for them.
